auditPolicy.activationRule: A city is ready only when all exact source IDs are covered, every visible label is unique and human, and every ambiguous, numbered, directional or operational label has an explicit exact-ID resolution.
auditPolicy.exhaustiveReview: Every official label in ranks 1-34 was inspected, not only planner lexical risks.
auditPolicy.exactAcceptRule: Accept is restricted to a complete official human-qualified place, facility or named land-use label and always targets one exact source ID.
auditPolicy.renameRule: Rename is restricted to an official IGN BD TOPO habitation toponym or named road with a cited coordinate strictly inside the exact source IRIS.
auditPolicy.mergeRule: Merge requires both connected geometry and proof of one shared human identity. No batch-A family met that full standard once unique contained toponyms were available, so merge count is zero.
auditPolicy.numberedFamilyDecision: Moulins, Meylan and Bischheim numbered cells retain 1:1 geometries and receive distinct contained official names; connectivity alone is never treated as semantic identity.
